title: Mordecai Stands Tall
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart who does what’s right even when it’s hard, and tonight Mordecai stays standing while everyone bows to proud Haman: Beau shakes his head at the teasing, says “That’s not kind,” and sits by the child who is sad.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he does what’s right even when it’s hard. In Beau’s world today: some kids were teasing another child, and they wanted Beau to join in. Beau felt his tummy flip, but he shook his head and said, “That’s not kind.” Then he went and sat by the child who was sad. Just like Mordecai stood tall for Heavenly Father, Beau stood tall for what was right, even when it wasn’t easy.
